svg.title: CH2 at 8 MS/s: every period folded - one clean trace
svg.desc: CH2 at 8 MS/s: every period folded - one clean trace. unit_interval: 9.90 us. frequency: 101 kHz. unit_interval_source: recovered from the signal. periods_folded: 13235. kind: data: phases carry both levels, so eye_width is the opening at the threshold. level_low: 864 mV. level_high: 2.88 V. threshold: 1.86 V. eye_height: 13.6 mV. eye_width: 9.90 us. eye_width_percent_of_ui: 100 %. jitter_tie_pp: 117 ns. jitter_cycle_to_cycle_pp: 146 ns. fitted_period: 9.90 us. unit interval recovered from 13236 rising crossings (median of 13235 intervals). the eye never closes: no sample falls between the two levels anywhere in the period, so eye_width is capped at one unit interval and says nothing about the edges — read the jitter numbers instead.
